coffee_total: total number of coffee berries in the season (berry/tree)
rho_b: CBB reproduction rate (1/day) at 24 C Jaramillo et al 2009
epsbe2rhob: ratio of exiting to reproduction rate (0, 1)
del_b: free-borer death rate (1/day) Romero and Cortina 2007
cu0: value to scale the total number of coffee berries
ci1: fraction of initial slightly infested coffee
b0: amount of free CBB at the start of the season (CBB/tree)
mu: number of CBB coming from outside in each season (CBB/tree)
